node.title: KoalaBear near-positive F02 mixed collision exclusions
node.closure: the two F02 mixed-allocation affine literal orbit representatives lie entirely on the forbidden repeated-J1 divisor
node.statement: Over characteristic p=2130706433, localize each of F02-A-RM and F02-OB-RM by the ten reconstruction-generated nonmonomial factors and the ambient torus units b,c,d. The resulting exact q-slice bases have sizes 6 and 7, and c-d has zero normal form in both quotients. Since q=(T-c)(T-d) is the locator of two distinct J1 labels, c-d is a required chart unit; saturation by c-d therefore gives the unit ideal. Independent one-step Rabinowitsch ideals using the product of all fourteen factors also return [1]. Hence both cells and their semantic transport orbits are empty over the algebraic closure and F_(p^6). All six F02 representatives are closed and the direct affine frontier decreases from 26 to 24.
